name: Diocles
description: The white-bearded veteran of the squad who has his shield arm shattered in the fight.

timeline.summary: Nikasios notices the cyclops's other leg was mauled rather than cut, and Kyrillos decides to investigate One-Eyed Pass since Eumalos's squad missed the rendezvous.
timeline.quote: there's something besides our soldiers in One-Eyed Pass that can drive off a cyclops. We're going to check it out.

timeline.summary: The squad finds nine beheaded, butchered Akroans in the pass, including Captain Eumalos, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks.
timeline.quote: There were nine Akroans lying on the ground, their bodies already bloating in the heat.

timeline.summary: Diocles realizes the minotaurs lured and trapped the squad deliberately and says Akros must be warned.
timeline.quote: The minotaurs are hunting the Alamon, deliberately.

timeline.summary: Pallas, injured, and the wounded Diocles and Nikasios stay to hold off more minotaurs while Leandros climbs out to warn Akros.
timeline.quote: Then more minotaurs poured into the canyon, and Leandros turned to climb the tumbled boulders.
